title: Make npm run lint pass on the source
objective: Correction of T-0004, which was archived on 2026-09-20 on a misread lint summary: the line reporting one auto-fixable error was taken for the total. With the local build output correctly ignored (eslint.config.mjs now ignores .sites-runtime/**), npm run lint still reports 46 errors in the source: 39 @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, 6 renders, 1 prefer-const; plus 38 warnings. Typing these is application work that can change behaviour if done carelessly, so lint is not configured as validation until the source passes; the two safe changes from T-0004 (requireThat takes unknown; the public route types its head row) stand.
acceptance: npm run lint exits 0 on a clean checkout and with a local portable build present, with each any replaced by the type the code actually handles and no behaviour change; typecheck, the portable suite and the browser suites still pass.
npm run lint is then added to every validation tier in project.json, with evidence recorded through the framework's validate.
non_goals: No rule disabling to make the count zero; the config's vendored-component exceptions stay as they are.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Work file by file from the lint output, starting with app/api/admin/route.ts, replacing any with the handled type and re-running typecheck and the portable suite after each file.
